brief.claim: Across tumour samples, the expression of gene A and the expression of gene B are positively related after accounting for the expression of gene C: the gain in R-squared when gene A expression is added to a linear regression of gene B expression on gene C expression is at least 0.05.

data_keys.meaning: Quantitative PCR expression signal of gene A in each tumour sample, in arbitrary linear units.
Quantitative PCR expression signal of gene B in each tumour sample, in arbitrary linear units.
Quantitative PCR expression signal of gene C in each tumour sample, in arbitrary linear units.

brief.sizes: samples = 96; gene_a_expression, gene_b_expression and gene_c_expression each have shape (96,).
